messages:
marta: Packaging handoff: preparing private-installer v1.9.2 for private/VPC canary. pushing airgap delta to mirror-A. quick pre-canary run shows a checksum mismatch on transit verification — holding canary until we understand.

ajay: saw the same. s3 staging vs offsite-mirror sha512 differ. grabbing replicator logs and upload traces now.

packaging-bot: build pipeline finished: artifact private-installer-v1.9.2.tgz uploaded. cosign signature created: cosign://sig-47b2. checksums recorded in manifest.json.

marta: signatures present but checksum mismatch is a red flag (could be transport truncation). @sophia can you fetch both objects and diff?

sophia: running local fetchs: `aws s3 cp s3://staging-bundles/private-installer-v1.9.2.tgz - | sha512sum` -> `a3f2c9...  -`
expected from CI manifest: `b7c3d4...  -`
current object looks truncated (size 14,327,201 vs expected 21,654,321).

ben: oncall here — hold canary. don't open the change window. rolling back canary would create noise; better to republish clean artifact. suggest re-upload and re-sign, then re-run transport checks.

ajay: replicator logs show a 408 during multipart complete at 03:12 UTC to mirror-A connector. likely transient. I'll abort the mirror push, re-upload to staging, and trigger the offsite push again. ETA ~18m.

marta: OK. pausing: deploy-bot, cancel the scheduled canary release for private-installer v1.9.2.

deploy-bot: aborting canary: private-installer v1.9.2 per request from marta. reason: artifact checksum mismatch detected during pre-release validation. all scheduled canaries canceled. :warning:

sophia: workflow for republish: 1) re-upload artifact from CI stable build agent 2) run `sha512sum` locally 3) `cosign sign` with staging key 4) push to mirror using `rsync --checksum --partial` 5) update manifest.json with new sha512 and cosign ref 6) run transport-verify job. I'll start steps 1–3 now.

packaging-bot: NOTE: update release-notes draft: mark v1.9.2 as "hold pending artifact reissue." Pin v1.9.1 in the Dedicated/Private release doc until we confirm the republish.

marta: decision: hold release. republish + re-sign + transport-verify required. if republish still fails, escalate to eng-infra (possible S3 connector bug) and consider delaying the public change window.

ben: acknowledged. I'll update the rollout calendar (change window) to a hold state: 2024-05-22 18:00 UTC paused. adding incident-style note in the runbook.

ajay: re-upload logs: `multipart upload resumed` -> `complete` -> `cosign: signature attached (cosign://sig-5f9a)` -> run checksums: new sha512 -> `b7c3d4...` matches expected manifest. pushing to mirror-A again with rsync.

sophia: verify: fetched mirror-A copy, sha512 matches b7c3d4..., cosign verify ok. rsync exit 0 to mirror-B and offsite. transport-verify job success: all hashes good across staging/mirror-A/mirror-B.

marta: good. schedule: reopen canary in +40m to allow caches to propagate. manual monitoring for first 10k tokens and first 50 canary hosts. keep rollback plan ready (pin back to v1.9.1 + abort traffic).

ben: I'll standby on the rollback path. notify support to watch for customer tickets; update the release-notes to reflect the short hold and the reason.

ajay: final checklist posted in the thread: `sha512 verified`, `cosign verified`, `manifest updated`, `deploy-bot canary re-schedule at 1748236950`, `monitoring hooks enabled` — pushing message to #incidents and ops-runbook.

marta: thanks everyone. big emphasis: if any checksum drift shows up again, escalate immediately. we'll keep packaging pipeline owners in the loop and open an infra ticket if replicator shows more 4xx errors. :thumbsup:
